correctness.rationale: Reconstructible uniform proof: natural squarefree Koszul cochains in each proper support are the augmented induced-forest cochains twisted by determinant, with exact ends. Alternating equivariant traces reduce to pointwise fixed vertices and fixed edges. Finite orbit enumeration yields all rotation and reflection formulas; the full-support polygon fundamental class gives the determinant-times-cycle-orientation top action. Rational transfer and averaged invariant Poincaré pairing prove the quotient formula. Two independent exact trace calculations, 29340 direct differential-equivariance tests, 368 full-support top trace checks and 276 integer quotient averages corroborate finite cases.

originality.rationale: The new assertion concerns explicit uniform character values in every previously untreated degree 5 through n-1, the top dihedral orientation character, and a sharp rational Poincaré-duality criterion. The classical Hochster/Koszul description gives nonequivariant groups and a computational model, but not the evaluated reflection and rotation character polynomials or quotient duality classification. Primary full-text comparisons differentiate finite coordinate-permutation quotients from torus-subgroup quotients. A plausible 2022 polygon-quotient paper remains full-text inaccessible and a genuine priority risk, not evidence of known coverage.
